senses.gloss: m. (preced.; cmp. form and meaning of כֵּהֶה) faint, feeble, dim; light in substance, thin.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:2">Neg. I, 2</cite> <he>של סיד דֵּיהָה הימנה</he> the red within the lime-colored leprosy is fainter than the latter, opp. <he>עז</he>; <cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 1:3">Tosef. ib. I, 3</cite> <he>דּוֹהֶא</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 3:11">Tosef. Nidd. III, 11</cite> <he>ד׳ מכאן</he> if fainter than this (shoe-black), opp. <cite ref="P00874"><he>עמוק</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 2:7">Nidd. II, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Niddah 20a:64">20ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ מכן</he>.

<cite ref="Gittin 57a:19">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>דיהה מן האור</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="D00226"><he>דוחה</he></cite>, read <he>דּוֹהָה</he>, fr. <cite ref="D00148"><he>דָּהָה</he></cite>) gets faint from the effect of the heat.
<cite ref="Yevamot 80b">Yeb. 80ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 10:6">Tosef. ib. X, 6</cite> <he>שכבת זרעו דוחה</he> his semen is watery, opp. <he>מקושר</he> cohesive; Tosef.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:2:7">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵃ</cite> bot. wherever the word <he>מורשה</he> (heirloom) is used, <he>לשין דיהא</he> it is a faint (vague) expression (not meant in its true sense as a real inheritance).
Ib. (ref. to Deut. XXXIII, 4) לית ד׳ סיגין וכ׳ there is none vaguer than this (morashah), for whosoever labors (studies), obtains the whole of it.—Pl. f. דֵּיהוֹת.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 3:2:9">Y. Ter. III, 42ᵇ</cite> top <he>ענבים ד׳</he> the juice of grapes is light in substance (incohesive).
